title: picard_residue_homology_source_fibre_comparison
statement:
Under the complete signature below, the derived residue fibre of the direct image of the pulled-back line bundle is additively equivalent to degree-one structure-sheaf cohomology of X_s; no affine representative is assumed.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem picard_residue_homology_source_fibre_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (τ : (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).ringCatSheaf)
    :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w ≃+
      Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)

source.place: Tags 0A1D, 0B91, 0BF2 and 01XK; derived base change, fibre trivialization and affine-base sections

proof.text: Tensor pullback agrees with ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, so G=pullback.fst f k applied to L is invertible. The base change fW=pullback.snd f k is proper and flat, hence quasi-compact and separated. Apply isIso_derivedBaseChange_of_flat_invertible to fW and the residue point of w. Then apply isIso_canonicalSinglePullbackMap to the invertible coefficient G to replace its derived pullback in degree zero by its ordinary pullback. This identifies the derived fibre with the derived image of the ordinary fibre coefficient.

The immersion k gives an isomorphism of residue fields, and hw transports the field at k(w) to that at s. Residue-point naturality identifies W.fromSpecResidueField w followed by k with S.fromSpecResidueField s preceded by the spectrum of that field isomorphism. Pullback universal properties identify the iterated fibre with X_s over this isomorphic spectrum. Use tensorPullbackCompositionIso to identify the pulled coefficient with the pullback of L_s. Pull back tau and use tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso to replace it with the structure module.

Apply degree-one derived homology and sections on Spec kappa(w), transporting scalars through GammaSpecIso. The upstream homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso computes the homology of the unbounded derived direct image as its first ordinary higher direct image. Scheme module sheaves have injective resolutions. Apply exists_addEquiv_sections_higherDirectImage_H to the quasi-compact separated fibre morphism and its quasi-coherent structure module over the affine field spectrum. Modules.H is abelian Sheaf.H, and the underlying sheaf of the unit module is structureSheafAb. Transport this cohomology along the fibre scheme isomorphism to X_s and forget the scalar actions.
